full_judgment: 4. The plaintiffs case, in short, is that the suit land originally belonged to Nabu Sheikh. Nabu Sheikh died leaving behind 3 sons of Nabu Sheikh did not pay rent to the land lords and surrendered the suit land in favour of land lords. Subsequently, Mothur Nath Shaha took settlement of the suit land from land lords. Mothur Nath Saha owned and possessed the suit land and after his death his heirs Meghlal, Nittananda, Radhika, Joggeshr and Mohananda inherited the suit land and possessed the same. That the plaintiffs have acquired the suit land by inheritance and successive purchase. The plaintiffs have mutated their names and have been paying rent to the government. The S.A. khatian of the suit land have been correctly prepared in the name of the plaintiffs. The defendants have no right, title, interest and possession in the suit land, but they tried to dispossess the plaintiffs therefore and hence, the suit.
